Overview.Name: PILLA VARSHINI
Overview.Goal: Healthy weight reduction, better confidence, and thyroid-friendly routine without stress.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + chicken curry + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + egg curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Chicken curry + vegetables + small cup rice
Option 2: Egg omelette + vegetables  + small cup rice
Option 3: Paneer curry + vegetables  + small cup rice

Notes_and_Tips: This plan focuses on growth, health, and confidence, not strict dieting.
Avoid fried foods most days as they trigger overeating.
Eat slowly and stop when comfortably full.
Maintain regular sleep and meal timing to support thyroid health.
During social gatherings, choose protein foods first before snacks.
Encourage daily movement and consistency rather than weight focus.
